title: eulophia gilletiana
intro: Eulophia gilletiana, commonly known as the Yellow Pencil Orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia gilletiana include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
